testcase.name: support-lifecycle/aks/1.34
testcase.system-out: warning: Kubernetes 1.34 leaves Azure Kubernetes Service standard support on 2026-11-30. Azure Kubernetes Service ends standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-11-30; extended support, which applies only if Long Term Support is enabled, then runs until 2027-11-30. AKS has no automatic extended support. Past community support a cluster is in platform support (Azure and AKS platform issues only, no Kubernetes fixes) unless Long Term Support is enabled, which needs the Premium tier. Fix: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support. References: - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/aks/supported-kubernetes-versions
